item.title: Innovation Party: "Mega Special Zone Act Must Withdraw '52-Hour Workweek Exemption'... Minimum Health Rights Cannot Be Bargained Away" (혁신당 “메가특구법 ‘주52시간 제외’ 철회해야…최소 건강권 흥정 안 돼”)
item.description:
The Cho Kuk Innovation Party criticized Industry Minister Kim Jung-gwan's remarks that the "Mega Special Zone Special Act" should include a provision exempting the 52-hour workweek cap, stating that "the minimum safety net for workers' health rights cannot be a subject of bargaining." The Innovation Party urged the government to "withdraw the plan to exempt the application of the 52-hour workweek." (조국혁신당이 ‘메가특구특별법’에 주 52시간 노동상한제 특례 조항을 담을 필요가 있다는 김정관 산업통상부 장관 발언에 대해 “노동자 건강권의 최소 안전판은 흥정이 대상이 될 수 없다”고 비판했다. 혁신당은 “주52시간제 적용 제외 구상을 철회하라”고 정부에 촉구했다.)

Kim Sun-min, chair of the Innovation Party's policy committee, said in a commentary on the 7th, "No causal relationship has been established between extended working hours and industrial competitiveness," adding, "The Semiconductor Special Act passed the National Assembly in January this year without any exemption clauses, and even under a law without exemptions, our semiconductor industry is posting record-breaking results. The claim that the 52-hour workweek is holding the industry back has already been refuted by reality." (김선민 혁신당 정책위의장은 7일 논평을 내어 “노동시간 연장과 산업 경쟁력 사이의 인과관계는 확인된 바 없다”며 “반도체특별법은 올해 1월, 예외 조항 없이 국회를 통과했고, 예외조항이 없는 법 아래에서도 우리 반도체 산업은 역대 최대 실적을 기록하고 있다. 주 52시간제가 산업의 발목을 잡는다는 주장은 이미 현실로 반박됐다”고 했다.)

Kim cited data from the office of Lee Yong-woo, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea. (김 정책위의장은 이용우 더불어민주당 의원실 자료를 인용했다.)

According to data received by Lee Yong-woo's office from the Ministry of Employment and Labor, from 2023 to April 2025, Samsung Electronics received approval for special extended work hours on grounds of semiconductor R&D in 25 cases, while SK Hynix received zero. However, during 2023–2024, when special extended work approvals were concentrated, SK Hynix's semiconductor operating profit surpassed that of Samsung Electronics. (이용우 의원실이 고용노동부에서 받은 자료를 보면, 2023년부터 2025년 4월까지 반도체 연구개발을 사유로 특별연장근로 인가를 받은 사례는 삼성전자가 25건, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 0건이었지만, 특별연장근로 인가가 집중된 2023~2024년 에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 반도체 영업이익이 삼성전자를 앞섰다.)

Kim said, "What determines semiconductor competitiveness is not long working hours but super-gap technology and business judgment—the report cards of the two companies prove this on their own." (김 정책위의장은 “반도체 경쟁력을 좌우하는 것은 장시간 노동이 아니라 초격차 기술력과 사업 판단이라는 사실을, 두 회사의 성적표가 스스로 증명하고 있다”고 했다.)

Kim also added, "As the National Samsung Electronics Labor Union has pointed out, in a situation where even the disclosure of hazardous substance information at semiconductor manufacturing sites is not properly carried out, if the 52-hour workweek is also made an exception, the price will be paid entirely with workers' lives and health." (김 정책위의장은 또한 “전국삼성전자노동조합이 지적하듯 반도체 제조현장의 유해물질 정보 공개조차 제대로 이루어지지 않는 상황에서, 주 52시간제마저 예외로 둔다면 그 대가는 고스란히 노동자의 생명과 건강이 치르게 될 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

On the 6th, Industry Minister Kim Jung-gwan said at a Kwanhun Club forum held at the Press Center in Jung-gu, Seoul, "The 52-hour workweek rule is necessary," but added, "The system should not suppress the will of people who want to work. There is a need to adjust the working hours system across advanced industries, not just semiconductors but also R&D, startups, and others." (지난 6일 김정관 산업통상부 장관은 서울 중구 프레스센터에서 열린 관훈토론회에서 “주52시간제 룰은 필요하다”면서도 “일하겠다는 사람들의 의지를 제도가 꺾어서는 안된다. 반도체(산업)뿐만 아니라 연구개발(R&D), 스타트업 등 첨단산업 전반에서 근로시간 제도를 손볼 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic, Innovation, and Progressive Party Legislative Judiciary Committee Members Urge Cho Hee-dae to Immediately Recommend Noh Tae-ak's Successor as Supreme Court Justice (민주·혁신·진보당 법사위원들 “조희대, 노태악 후임 대법관 즉시 제청하라”)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the Democratic Party of Korea, the Innovation Party, and the Progressive Party on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee urged Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae to promptly recommend a successor to fill the vacancy left by former Supreme Court Justice Noh Tae-ak. (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 더불어민주당·조국혁신당·진보당 의원들이 조희대 대법원장을 향해 조속하게 노태악 전 대법관의 후임 대법관 임명 제청을 하라고 촉구했다.)

Seo Yeong-gyo, the committee chair from the Democratic Party, and Kim Seung-won, the ruling party's secretary on the committee from the same party, issued a statement on the 7th at the National Assembly on behalf of "all Democratic, Innovation, and Progressive Party lawmakers on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee," urging that "Chief Justice Cho must not turn a blind eye to his constitutional duty and should immediately recommend a Supreme Court justice to normalize the judiciary." (민주당 소속 서영교 법사위원장과 같은당 김승원 법사위 여당 간사는 7일 국회에서 ‘국회 법사위 소속 민주당·혁신당·진보당 의원 일동’ 명의의 기자회견문을 발표하며 “조 대법원장은 본인에게 부여된 헌법상 의무를 외면하지 말고 즉시 대법관을 제청해 사법부 정상화에 나서야 한다”고 촉구했다.)

The recommendation for the successor to former Justice Noh, who retired on March 3, has been pending for over six months since the Justice Candidate Recommendation Committee proposed four candidates on January 21: Seoul High Court judges Kim Min-gi and Park Soon-young, Seoul High Court senior judge Yoon Seong-sik, and Daegu District Court senior judge Son Bong-gi. Article 104 of the Constitution stipulates that "Supreme Court justices shall be appointed by the President with the consent of the National Assembly, upon the recommendation of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court." (지난 3월3일 퇴임한 노 전 대법관 후임 제청은 대법관후보추천위원회가 1월21일 김민기·박순영 서울고법 판사, 윤성식 서울고법 부장판사, 손봉기 대구지법 부장판사 등 4명을 추천한 이후 6개월 넘게 조 대법원장의 제청이 이뤄지지 않고 있다. 헌법 104조는 ‘대법관은 대법원장 제청으로 국회 동의를 얻어 대통령이 임명한다’고 규정하고 있다.)

They stated, "Recommending an appointment is not a matter of the Chief Justice's discretion but a duty imposed by the Constitution, yet Chief Justice Cho has effectively refused to make the recommendation," adding, "With the existing vacancy unresolved, an abnormal situation has even arisen where the selection process for the successor to Justice Lee Heung-gu, who retires in September, is proceeding first." (이들은 “임명 제청은 대법원장의 재량이 아니라 헌법이 부여한 책무이지만 조 대법원장은 제청을 사실상 거부하고 있다”며 “기존 공석조차 해소하지 못한 상황에서 오는 9월 퇴임하는 이흥구 대법관의 후임 인선 절차가 먼저 진행되는 비정상적 상황까지 초래됐다”고 했다.)

They further said, "In a reality where a single Supreme Court justice handles hundreds of cases each month, a prolonged vacancy directly leads to delays in trials," and "Chief Justice Cho emphasized the 'right to a speedy trial' in his inaugural address, but now he is betraying that promise himself." (이어 이들은 “대법관 한명이 매달 수백 건의 사건을 처리하는 현실에서 장기간 공석은 재판 지연으로 직결된다”며 “조 대법원장은 취임사에서 ‘신속한 재판을 받을 권리’를 강조했지만 지금은 그 약속을 스스로 저버리고 있다”고 했다.)

Additionally, they stated, "The Supreme Court must not delay deliberations on major insurrection cases either." (아울러, 이들은 “대법원은 주요 내란 사건에 대한 심리 역시 지연해서는 안 된다”고도 했다.)

They noted, "With the cases of former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo and former Minister of the Interior and Safety Lee Sang-min referred to the en banc panel, it has become difficult to uphold the speedy trial principle set by the special counsel law," and "If the en banc panel presents legal reasoning that the public finds hard to accept or overturns lower court rulings, this could go beyond mere case-by-case judgments and shake the historical assessment of the constitutional order itself." (이들은 “한덕수 전 국무총리와 이상민 전 행정안전부 장관 사건이 전원합의체에 회부되면서 특검법이 정한 신속 재판 원칙이 지켜지기 어려운 상황에 놓였다”며 “만약 전원합의체가 국민이 납득하기 어려운 법리를 제시하거나 하급심 판단을 뒤집는다면, 이는 단순한 개별 사건의 판단을 넘어 헌정질서에 대한 역사적 평가까지 흔들 수 있다”고 했다.)

They added, "With the recommendation of Supreme Court justices delayed, insurrection cases stalled, and the Kim Keon-hee case also postponed, the Cho Hee-dae judiciary will find it hard to avoid criticism of 'politicization of the judiciary' in its current state." (이들은 “대법관 제청은 미루고, 내란 사건은 늦추고, 김건희 사건도 지연시키는 지금의 모습으로는 조희대 사법부가 ‘사법의 정치화’라는 비판을 피하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

With Chief Justice Cho having postponed recommending a successor for former Justice Noh Tae-ak, whose term ended on March 3, the Justice Candidate Recommendation Committee is scheduled to convene on the 4th to discuss the successor for Justice Lee Heung-gu, who retires on the 7th of next month. The selection process for another Supreme Court justice has begun while the vacancy left by former Justice Noh remains unfilled. (조 대법원장이 지난 3월3일 임기가 끝난 노태악 전 대법관 후임 대법관 제청을 미룬 상태에서, 다음달 7일 퇴임하는 이흥구 대법관 후임을 논의하는 대법관후보추천위원회가 4일 열릴 예정이다. 노 전 대법관 후임 대법관 인선이 이뤄지지 않은 상태에서 또 다른 대법관 후임의 인선 절차가 시작된 것이다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Fierce Democratic Party Primary, Can It Write a Different Ending from the Movie 'Friend' [Oops Gura] (치열한 민주당 경선, 영화 ‘친구’와 다른 결말 쓸 수 있을까 [웁스구라])
item.description:
Long ago, I once interviewed a 'Jehovah's Witness' believer who had been forcibly dragged into the military after refusing conscription. Classified as a problem soldier, he was led by a senior's hand to a church inside the military base during his early days as a new recruit, where he met a senior military chaplain. A military chaplain is a position within the military that assists the chaplaincy officer and supports religious events such as worship and prayer, and is held by devout Christians who majored in theology, Christian education, or Christian studies. That senior, being ignorant of religion, thought that since they were 'fellow Christians (?)', the chaplain might offer some help to the new recruit classified as a problem soldier, and arranged the meeting—but that expectation produced the exact opposite result. During their conversation, the chaplain suddenly flew into a rage and slapped the new recruit across the face. Shocked, the senior led the recruit out of the church, dumbfounded, saying, "What kind of chaplain hits people? Even I never hit him..." <<> When people who are seen from the outside as belonging to factions of similar colors clash internally, they sometimes fight more fiercely and brutally than against their enemies. Watching the ongoing primary process to elect the party leader and supreme council members of the Democratic Party of Korea, that thought comes to mind. The war of nerves that had been going on even before the primary began has expanded into full-fledged internal strife the moment the primary started. Jung Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok, the two candidates, have announced they will refer each other to the ethics committee over the Shincheonji issue and the birthday-based voting issue, and their respective supporting party members have begun signing petitions demanding disciplinary action against the opposing candidates. At the joint rallies in Chungcheong and Busan·Ulsan·South Gyeongsang, not only the party leader candidates but even the supreme council candidates shouted 'traitor' and 'anti-party figure' at each other, with slander and venomous remarks running rampant. The organizers prevented people from bringing slogans or promotional materials into the venues, so at least those couldn't be captured in photos, but the candidates' over-the-line remarks, along with the shouts and jeers of supporters, spread unfiltered through broadcasts and social media services (SNS) like YouTube. Excessive hatred and blind support are grabbing each other's ankles and dragging everyone down the path to ruin. <<> The discord between the president and the party began long ago. The fear that a lame duck status would arrive just one year into the term weighed heavily on the Blue House. The Blue House sent signals seemingly favoring former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, but his political clout appears to fall short of that, as he remains in a neck-and-neck race with former Representative Jung Cheong-rae. <<> Meanwhile, the aftershocks of the Criminal Procedure Act revision, stock prices lurching like a roller coaster, and the real estate tax reform proposal are no small challenges, yet the president's approval rating has fallen below 50 percent and the party's support remains sluggish. Inside the Democratic Party, it's said that the word on the street is 'whether it's Jung or Kim, whoever wins, they're doomed.' There are analyses suggesting that the 2028 general election is in jeopardy at this rate. There's even a joke that the party's only reliable relief pitcher right now is, paradoxically, 'Jang Dong-hyuk,' but unless conservatives are fools, he probably won't last long either. <<> The movie 'Friend,' which tells the tragic story of two closest friends who become enemies and eventually one kills the other, features this line: "Hey, do you know who'd win if Jo Oh-ryeon raced a sea turtle in swimming?" It's said while reminiscing about past memories ahead of a war aimed at a friend. I wish people would pause the hatred driven by blind support for a beat and reflect on themselves. In the movie, it ends in catastrophe, but couldn't reality be different? <<> Yoon Woon-sik, Senior Reporteryws@hani.co.kr (오래 전 병역을 거부하다 어쩔수 없이 군대에 끌려간 ‘여호와의 증인’ 신자를 취재로 만난 적이 있었다. 문제사병으로 분류된 그는 신병 때 선임의 손에 이끌려 군대 안 교회에서 가서, 한참 고참인 군종병을 만난 적이 있다. 군종병은 군종장교 보좌와 예배·기도 등 종교행사 지원 업무를 수행하는 군대 내 보직으로 신학, 기독교교육, 기독교학 등을 전공한 신실한 기독교인이다. 그 선임은 종교에 무지했던 터라 그래도 ‘같은 기독교(?)’이니 문제사병으로 분류된 신병에게 뭔가 도움을 주겠지라는 생각을 가지고 만나게 해줬는데 그 기대는 정반대의 결과를 낳았다. 대화를 나누던 군종이 화를 내면서 갑자기 신병의 뺨을 때렸던 것이다. 깜짝 놀란 선임이 신병을 데리고 교회를 나오면서 “아니, 뭔 군종이라는 인간이 사람을 때리나? 나도 안 때렸는데...”라며 어이없어 했다.)

item.title: Foreign Ministry Says "No Discriminatory Elements Against U.S. Companies"... Rebuts U.S. Lawmakers' Protest Letter on Network Act (외교부 “미국 기업 차별 요소 없어”…미 의원들 정통망법 항의 서한에 반박)
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry on the 7th rebutted claims by Republican members of the U.S. House Judiciary Committee, who sent a protest letter arguing that the Information and Communications Network Act (Network Act) could harm American companies through political censorship, stating that it contains "no discriminatory elements." (외교부가 7일 정보통신망법(정통망법)이 정치적 검열 등으로 미국 기업에 피해를 줄 수 있다는 항의 서한을 보낸 미국 하원 공화당 소속 법사위원회 의원들의 주장에 대해 “차별적 요소가 없다”고 반박했다.)

A Foreign Ministry official said on that day, "This legislation was pursued with the aim of addressing social harms arising from changes in the digital environment and strengthening user protection," adding, "It does not include any discriminatory elements against U.S. companies." The official further stated, "Considering the purpose behind the legislation, the government will actively explain the intent and effects of the bill to the U.S. Judiciary Committee through collaboration among relevant ministries." (외교부 당국자는 이날 “ 이 법안은 디지털 환경 변화에 따른 사회적 폐해에 대응하고 이용자 보호를 강화하기 위한 취지에서 추진됐다”며 “미국 기업에 대한 차별적 요소를 포함하고 있지 않다”고 말했다. 이어 “정부는 이 법안이 마련된 취지를 고려해, 관계부처 간 협업 하에 미 법사위에 법안의 도입 취지와 효과 등을 적극적으로 설명해 나갈 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

On the 6th (local time), four Republican lawmakers, including House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan (Ohio), sent a letter to the Broadcasting, Media, and Communications Commission (BMCC) expressing concerns about South Korea's Network Act. (지난 6일(현지시각) 미 하원 법사위원장인 짐 조던(오하이오) 의원 등 공화당 의원 4명은 방송미디어통신위원회(방미통위)에 서한을 보내 한국의 정통망법에 대한 우려를 표명했다.)

They argued that the Network Act has "vague and unclear scope of application" and "raises concerns that it could be used to censor politically opposing viewpoints." They also claimed that "the amendment particularly targets American companies" and that it "would enable the BMCC to punish U.S. companies and users who exercise constitutionally protected rights." (이들은 정통망법이 “적용 범위가 모호하고 명확하지 않다”며 “정치적으로 반대되는 의견을 검열하는 데 (법안이) 이용될 수 있다는 우려를 제기한다”고 주장했다. 또 “개정안은 특히 미국 기업들을 대상으로 하고 있다”며 “방미통위가 헌법으로 보호되는 권리를 행사한 미국 기업과 이용자들을 처벌할 수 있도록 하게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

The amended Network Act, which took effect on the 7th, imposes obligations on platform operators such as Naver, Kakao, Google, Meta, and X to delete or block false and manipulated information, along with penalty provisions. (지난 7일부터 시행에 들어간 개정 정통망법은 네이버, 카카오, 구글, 메타, 엑스(X) 등 플랫폼 사업자에게 허위·조작 정보에 대한 삭제·차단 의무를 부과하는 내용과 벌칙 조항이 담겼다.)

Chairman Jim Jordan and Rep. Scott Fitzgerald (Wisconsin), who sent the letter, also released a Judiciary Committee report last month alleging that the South Korean government was discriminating against Coupang. In the report, they characterized the South Korean government's investigations and sanctions against Coupang as "harassment" and argued that discrimination against Coupang constituted a violation of the U.S.-Korea trade agreement. (이번 서한을 발송한 짐 조던 위원장과 스콧 피츠제럴드(위스콘신) 의원은 지난달 한국 정부가 쿠팡을 차별하고 있다는 내용의 법사위 보고서도 발표한 바 있다. 보고서에서 이들은 쿠팡에 대한 한국 정부의 조사 및 제재를 ‘괴롭힘’이라고 표현하며, 쿠팡에 대한 차별은 한미 무역합의 위반이라고 주장했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Military Must Restore Public Trust Lost Due to Insurrection" (이 대통령 “군, 내란으로 떨어진 국민 신뢰 회복해야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung urged newly promoted generals on the 7th to restore the military's credibility, saying, "The recurrence of insurrection has left us with the task of regaining the public's trust." (이재명 대통령이 7일 진급 장성들에게 “다시 발생한 내란으로 국민 신뢰를 회복해야 할 과제가 있다”며 군 신뢰 회복을 당부했다.)

At Cheong Wa Dae that day, the President received promotion reports from Army Gen. Lee Sang-ryeol (Commander of the Ground Operations Command), Air Force Lt. Gen. Park Heung-jae (Superintendent of the Air Force Academy), Army Lt. Gen. Yun Han-il (Chief of Staff of the Ground Operations Command), and Navy Vice Adm. Cho Chung-ho (Vice Chief of Naval Operations), and presented them with the samjeonggeom tassel ornament (a decorative cord attached to the sword). The samjeonggeom is awarded upon promotion to brigadier general, symbolizing the army, navy, and air force's shared commitment to the spirit of national defense, unification, and prosperity; upon promotion to lieutenant general or general, the tassel bears the names of the President and the recipient. <<> According to Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong, during a conversation following the ceremony, President Lee said, "There has been a long effort to restore trust in the military from the history of military regimes, but the recurrence of insurrection has left us with the task of regaining the public's trust.
